sanskrit_verse: विधिदत्तं विषं येन जीर्णं मन्त्रौषधं विना । स शुद्धः स्यादन्यथा तु दण्ड्यो दाप्यश्च तद्धनम् ॥
transliteration: vidhidattaṃ viṣaṃ yena jīrṇaṃ mantrauṣadhaṃ vinā | sa śuddhaḥ syād anyathā tu daṇḍyo dāpyaś ca taddhanam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who has digested poison given by lawful authority without recourse to mantra or medicine is pure; otherwise, he becomes liable for corrective restoration and must forfeit equivalent wealth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as determinant of lawful action
Causation through conscious intent and means
Capacity-based responsibility tied to knowledge and remedy access
Restoration logic rooted in energetic alignment
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual ingests a substance under lawful directive AND no unauthorized countermeasures are used THEN status = purified
IF an individual ingests a substance under lawful directive AND unauthorized remedies are applied THEN liability = corrective restoration + asset forfeiture equal to harm potential
IF no lawful directive exists for ingestion THEN default = assessment of energetic misalignment and capacity deficit
All asset forfeitures must be directed toward systemic dharmic correction funds
supreme_court_application: In cases involving state-sanctioned trials or spiritual tests where bodily integrity is at risk, the Supreme Court must determine whether the subject acted within authorized parameters and without external interference. If unauthorized mitigation occurred, corrective restoration shall occur alongside proportional financial realignment to restore energetic balance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that purity follows lawful ingestion without contravention. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows deviation arises only upon introduction of unapproved mitigating factors. Responsibility is proportional to disruption of lawful process. No punitive consequence is enacted—only completion and energetic rebalancing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-administer the lawful trial under supervision
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Public declaration of energetic misstep
Capacity Restoration: Instruction in proper use of sanctioned remedial tools
Integrity Reintegration: Financial redistribution to dharmic institutions
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
